auditDispositions.basis: The immutable 82-case corpus, 164 backend dispositions, 769 assertions, 166 exact-artifact outcomes per backend, 6,004 exact-tip unit tests, 2,485 exact-tip PostgreSQL E2E tests, and current browser outcome checks cover the release delta. Characteristic coverage is enumerated without an exhaustive Cartesian claim.

Permanent API response-contract suites, exact outer-key allowlists, no-underscore checks, the exact interrupted-create envelope receipt, and 166 built-live outcomes per backend passed. No API tree changed after the release merge.

Repository, filter, conditional-write, diagnostics, exact interrupted-create, bulk and global-error suites passed in the exact-tip 2,485-test PostgreSQL E2E run. Exact error receipts assert status, SCIM type, diagnostics keys, non-mutation and driver-detail suppression.

Logging configuration, endpoint-scoped logs, diagnostics enrichment, request-body privacy and auth decision suites passed in exact-tip unit/E2E and live evidence. No new runtime logging path exists in this assurance follow-up.

RFC declaration/default, type, cardinality, required, mutability, returned, caseExact, uniqueness, primary and retained-entry behavior is mapped to permanent two-backend evidence in SCIM_CHARACTERISTIC_RECONCILIATION.md.

PRs 188 and 190 have successful CodeQL and validate checks. The release image passed Trivy; production dependency audit had zero HIGH or CRITICAL findings. Auth, credential, response-leak, security-header and input-validation tests remained green.

The 50,000-row benchmark measures indexed and residual paths, selectivity, transferred rows and bytes, database and service latency, and RSS. Residual JSONB filtering is correct but materializes all candidates; schema-aware pushdown remains a separate optimization contract.

Package-scoped independent reviews closed their findings before integration. The assurance follow-up changes scripts, contracts and documentation only, with no production TypeScript or API tree delta. Harness changes are narrow and covered by executable contracts.

The design, RCA, changelog, session context, assistant context, documentation index, engineering patterns and this final evidence receipt were reconciled. Mechanical content, freshness, JSON and Mermaid gates are required before merge.
